title: PrettyMD
brief: A markdown viewer "for vibe coders" — a simple, beautiful app for reading the .md files your AI writes: specs, plans, skills, agents and more. Pairs naturally with agent-heavy workflows.
details: PrettyMD (prettymd.app) is a markdown viewer built for the vibe-coding workflow — "a markdown viewer for vibe coders." It renders the .md files your AI writes (specs, plans, skills, AGENTS.md) beautifully, and its two killer features close the loop with your agent: highlight any line and leave a comment that your agent picks up and replies to right there, and a change-highlighter that shows what's new since you last looked so you read only the changed lines. Comments live in a plain `.md.comments.json` sidecar your agent can also write to (agent comments are tagged by name). Also: outline navigation, tabs, instant search, focus mode, keyboard-first shortcuts, Mermaid/code/full Markdown spec support, light and dark themes, Mac and Windows, fully offline. One-time $19 lifetime license (not a subscription), 7-day free trial with no credit card, free updates forever, two computers per license. Solo-built by Somya.
